title: Your First Weekend at Allegheny College, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Family Picnic on the Lawn
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Kickoff
cards.notes: Join the traditional family picnic on Caflisch Lawn to meet the college president and say your final goodbyes before orientation begins.
cards.short_summary: A traditional welcome picnic for new students and their families held on the lawn of Caflisch Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Family Picnic is held at Caflisch Lawn on the Friday of orientation weekend, followed by a Family Farewell.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and their families during orientation Friday afternoon.

cards.entity_name: David V. Wise Sport and Fitness Center
cards.title: The Class of 2030 Photo
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Tradition
cards.notes: Head to the Blue Courts at the Wise Center to gather with your entire incoming class for the official group photo.
cards.short_summary: New students gather at the Wise Center's Blue Courts for their first official class photograph.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 2030 Photo is scheduled for 5:45 pm on Friday at the Wise Center Blue Courts.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Required event for new students; typically held in the evening on the first Friday.

cards.title: Breakfast at Brooks
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Fuel
cards.notes: Meet your Orientation Leader for a buffet-style breakfast in this historic campus landmark before the day's sessions begin.
cards.short_summary: The primary all-you-care-to-eat dining hall where students gather for orientation meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation Leader meetings and breakfast are held at Brooks Dining Hall on Saturday morning starting at 9:30 am.
cards.access_notes: Weekend breakfast/brunch hours are 10:30 am to 2:00 pm for general service.

cards.title: Required Student Sessions
cards.subtitle: Saturday Academic Intro
cards.notes: Attend rotations of required new student sessions in the library to learn about academic resources and campus life.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library serves as the hub for academic orientation sessions during the first weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Required New Student Sessions are held in rotations at Pelletier Library on Saturday from 9:00 am to 2:30 pm.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Library is used for orientation sessions; regular weekend hours vary by semester.

cards.title: The Classroom Quest
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Navigation
cards.notes: Take a self-guided walk through campus buildings to locate your specific classrooms before Monday's first bell.
cards.short_summary: A designated time for new students to explore campus and find their academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: Classroom Quest is a self-guided time from 3:30 pm to 5:00 pm on Saturday for students to find their classrooms.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Self-guided activity across all academic buildings on campus.

cards.title: Evening on the Gator Quad
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Social
cards.notes: Gather on the central quad for evening activities hosted by student organizations to meet your new classmates.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor gathering space on campus, used for social events and orientation activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation Leader meetings and opening activities are frequently held at the Gator Quad.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; primary site for outdoor student life events.

cards.title: Visit the Market House
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Outing
cards.notes: Walk downtown to the 'Heart of Meadville' for local produce, baked goods, and a taste of the local community.
cards.short_summary: A historic community market in downtown Meadville offering local food and artisan crafts.
cards.evidence_claim: The historic Meadville Market House is described as a destination for local goods and is within walking distance of campus.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; check seasonal hours for Sunday community markets.

cards.title: The Historic Bentley Hall
cards.subtitle: Sunday Campus Exploration
cards.notes: Visit the oldest building on campus to see the site where you will eventually march through the doors at graduation.
cards.short_summary: The iconic Federalist-style building that serves as the symbolic heart of Allegheny College.
cards.evidence_claim: Bentley Hall is the first building on campus and is central to the Commencement tradition where seniors march through its doors.
cards.access_notes: Exterior is viewable anytime; interior houses administrative offices.

cards.title: Dinner at McKinley's
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Meal
cards.notes: Grab a casual dinner at the Campus Center's food court, a popular spot for meeting friends before the first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: A retail-style food court located in the Henderson Campus Center offering various dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: McKinley's Food Court is located in the Campus Center and is open on Sundays from 11:00 am to 10:30 pm.
cards.access_notes: Open late on Sundays until 10:30 pm for student dining.

cards.title: First Floor Meeting
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Wrap-up
cards.notes: Meet your Resident Assistant and neighbors to discuss community standards and upcoming hall events.
cards.short_summary: Mandatory meetings for residents to build community and learn hall policies.
cards.evidence_claim: Residence Hall Floor Meetings are held at 8:00 pm on the first Friday and recurringly to meet the community.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Held within individual residence halls for assigned residents.
